subject: Usage rectification and final one-time charge for May overage
messages:
From: Khaleel Ibrahim <khaleel@edgegrid.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, billing@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Question on May usage / request for true-up

Hi Ben / Redwood billing team,

We ran a reconciliation against our May usage and found an unanticipated spike in token consumption tied to a short-lived batch job that started after our renewal on 5/1. We weren't able to throttle quickly enough; the delta sits outside our committed capacity and looks like ~115k extra tokens.

Can you please: 1) confirm how you intend to calculate a one-time true-up for May, 2) provide a provisional invoice we can route to procurement, and 3) confirm if any credit can be applied against July usage? I attached our raw usage export for May.

Attachments: edgegrid_usage_export_May2026.csv (CSV, 42KB)

Thanks,
Khaleel
Khaleel Ibrahim
Head of Platform Engineering | EdgeGrid Inc.
khaleel@edgegrid.ai
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Khaleel Ibrahim <khaleel@edgegrid.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on May usage / request for true-up

Hi Khaleel — thanks for flagging this and for the export. I've looped in Monica from Finance and Grace from CS so we can reconcile the numbers and get an invoice out quickly.

Next steps from our side:
- Monica: will run a quick rate/reconciliation based on the export and the contract terms.
- Grace: will confirm whether you qualify for a one-time credit against July usage as a customer courtesy.

Can you confirm the PO contact and whether EdgeGrid prefers a single one-time invoice or a split payment (2x)? If you have a purchase order number, send it over and we'll include it on the invoice.

I can also schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful; happy to walk through the calc.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: Khaleel Ibrahim <khaleel@edgegrid.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-20T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on May usage / request for true-up

Hi Khaleel — Monica from Finance here. I took the usage export and applied the contracted unit rate and the uplift terms from your renewal (signed 2026-05-01). Preliminary reconciliation:

- Gross overage (uncommitted tokens): 115,384 tokens
- Applied unit rate: $0.108 per 1k tokens (as per contract schedule) -> $12,456.67
- Taxes / fees excluded in this estimate; final invoice will include sales tax where applicable.

I've attached the calc workbook (edgegrid_trueup_calc_v1.xlsx) with the line-by-line breakdown. Two quick questions: do you want this posted as a single one-time invoice, or would you prefer we split it 50/50 across two invoices with net-30 each? We can also apply a one-time 10% pre-pay/commit credit if you'd like to treat this as an 'early top-up' rather than pure overage — that would reduce the one-time amount.

Please confirm PO details and preferred billing cadence. Once we have confirmation, I'll issue INV-2026-1187 and route it to accounts-payable.

Attachments: edgegrid_trueup_calc_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 38KB)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Khaleel Ibrahim <khaleel@edgegrid.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Leah Nguyen <leah.nguyen@edgegrid.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on May usage / request for true-up

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and the workbook. The calculation looks right on the face of it. We would prefer the pre-pay adjustment route if possible (apply as credit against future usage) — that aligns better with our purchasing cadence.

Procurement (copied) prefers a single invoice for our internal workflow. PO contact is procurement@edgegrid.ai and PO number will be PO-EDGE-2026-429 (we'll confirm the formal PO by EOD Friday).

If you can apply the 10% pre-pay credit, please re-issue the invoice with the adjusted total and note the credit line item. We should be able to settle within standard terms once the PO is attached.

Thanks,
Khaleel
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Khaleel Ibrahim <khaleel@edgegrid.ai>, Leah Nguyen <leah.nguyen@edgegrid.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final invoice and payment instructions — INV-2026-1187

Hi Khaleel / Leah — appreciate the confirmation and the PO number. Per your request we applied the 10% pre-pay credit and re-issued the one-time invoice:

- Gross overage: $12,456.67
- 10% pre-pay credit: -$1,245.67
- Subtotal: $11,211.00
- Sales tax / jurisdictional fees to be added if applicable on the final PDF

Invoice: INV-2026-1187 (attached as INV-2026-1187-final.pdf). Please route against PO-EDGE-2026-429. Payment methods accepted: wire transfer (instructions on the invoice), ACH, or card. If you need a split payment, confirm and we can issue two invoices with adjusted numbers.

We also added a one-time credit line noting that $1,245.67 will be applied to July usage if payment is received within net-30. The signed amendment to reflect the true-up will be available via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/12345/EG-amendment (link attached in amendment-docusign-link.txt).

Attachments: INV-2026-1187-final.pdf (PDF, 9KB), amendment-docusign-link.txt (URL stub)

If anything looks off on the invoice, flag it and Monica will re-open the calc. Otherwise we'll mark this thread closed once payment is posted.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
thread_summary: EdgeGrid reported a May usage spike after renewal. Redwood calculated a $12,456.67 gross overage, applied a 10% pre-pay credit per customer request, and issued INV-2026-1187 for $11,211. Invoice and DocuSign amendment link provided; payment to be routed against PO-EDGE-2026-429. Thread closed pending payment.
